question: Kodon, Kutki, Hraka, Bauti are examples of _______
solution:
The correct answer is __**millets**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kodon, Kutki, Hraka, Bauti** are examples of **millets**.
 
• Millets are a group of highly variable small-seeded grasses, widely grown around the world as **cereal crops or grains**.
 
• They are rich in** fiber and protein**,
